title: Do Not Let the Prior Heal the Anomaly: Selective Anchoring for Detection from Incomplete Measurements
abstract: arXiv:2611.33331v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative priors can recover anatomical detail from incomplete medical measurements, but may erase the very lesions that imaging aims to detect, even when the measurements contain evidence of them. We introduce selective anchoring that protects reliably measured image components from prior-driven changes, while allowing expressive generative models to reconstruct unresolved structure. Acquisition uncertainty in the protected components is either added deterministically to the downstream test or carried by the ensemble through stochastic perturbations of the readings. We implement this principle as a wrapper for pretrained diffusion and flow samplers and as AnchoredFM, a fast constrained flow model. Under a linear-Gaussian measurement model, the protected coefficients are unbiased in expectation and achieve nominal interval coverage across repeated acquisitions, independently of the learned prior. translated_title: 勿让先验“治愈”异常：面向不完整测量检测的选择性锚定方法
translated_abstract: 生成式先验能够从不完整的医学测量数据中恢复解剖细节，但可能会抹除影像检查本意要检测的病灶，即使测量数据中已包含这些病灶的证据。我们提出选择性锚定方法，保护可靠测量的图像分量免受先验驱动的改变，同时允许表达力强的生成模型重建尚未解析的结构。受保护分量的采集不确定性既可以以确定性方式加入到下游检验中，也可以通过对读数进行随机扰动由集成方法承载。我们将该原则实现为预训练扩散模型和流模型采样器的包装器，并实现为AnchoredFM——一种快速的受约束流模型。在线性高斯测量模型下，受保护系数在期望意义上是无偏的，并且在重复采集过程中达到名义区间覆盖率，且这一保证独立于所学习的先验。在稀疏视角CT、加速脑部……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“选择性锚定”方法，在使用生成式先验从不完整测量中重建医学影像时，保护可靠测量的图像分量不被先验抹除病灶，并提供与所学先验无关的无偏估计与名义区间覆盖保证，具体实现为扩散/流采样器的包装器及快速的AnchoredFM模型。
en_tdlr: Selective anchoring protects reliably measured image components from being erased by generative priors during reconstruction from incomplete measurements, yielding unbiased, prior-independent interval coverage guarantees, implemented both as a wrapper for pretrained diffusion and flow samplers and as the fast constrained flow model AnchoredFM.
